messages:
katie-sales: quick sync — SparkBridge POC perf plan. They want 250 qps sustained, 500 qps bursts for 30s, 95p <150ms for ~1k token prompts. Can engineering confirm load generator config and if dedicated commit pricing covers burst? Also security wants SOC2 + KMS answers in the questionnaire (attached).

alex-eng: we can run a multi-stage load: warmup 5m, ramp to 250 qps over 3m, maintain 60m, then 3x 30s bursts at 500 qps. Recommend using model v2-13b-quant (int8) for cost parity. Suggest prefix/KV caching enabled and batching target = 8.

ravi-ml: quantization will reduce mem and cost, but watch token-decode perf for >1k sequences. With int8 and batching=8, expected p95 ~120ms on p4d-like hardware. KV cache hit rate is critical — what's expected cacheability from customer traffic?

maria-ops: I'll provision a dedicated pool (4 x A10g-equivalent). Autoscale min=2, max=8. Plan canary in us-west then eu-west. Need exact sim script to run; aiming to execute in staging tomorrow 03:00 PDT.

katie-sales: customer asks about logs/PII: can we exclude request bodies from analytics during the POC? Also they need network encryption details for the questionnaire. Sasha any blockers?

sasha-sec: we can provide SOC2 summary, KMS integration doc, and a per-tenant log-exclusion flag in the Console for POCs. One caveat: SparkBridge requested HSM-backed key attestations (SKI) — legal + infra will need to sign off, may add timeline.

alex-eng: load generator example (k6-style). Use this as baseline for scripts:
```
loadgen --target 250 --ramp 180 --duration 3600 --burst 500 --burst-duration 30 --payload-file prompts.json
```
Token distribution: 80% in 500-1k, 20% >1k. Enable prefix sampling to model cache hits.

ravi-ml: back-of-envelope perf & cost: with batching=8, int8, and ~60% prefix cache hit, expect steady p95 ~110-130ms and approx $0.70-0.85 per 1k requests (model inference cost only). If cache disabled, cost increases ~2-3x. Recommend we offer a 25% POC promo on committed hours to reduce friction.

maria-ops: provisioning ETA: ~6h after PO. I'll run the canary tomorrow 03:00 PDT and capture p50/p95/p99, GPU util, mem, and KV cache hit. Results -> sales/poc-results folder.

katie-sales: question from SparkBridge: during autoscale will clients encounter 429s? They want predictable burst behavior.

alex-eng: our runtime does graceful queueing with short backpressure windows; scale-up is fast but not instant. During transient oversubscribe, clients may see sub-second queuing; sustained overload => 429. Recommend client-side retry with exponential backoff + jitter. We can also provision a short burst buffer (reserved tokens) as part of the POC.

sasha-sec: I'll complete the questionnaire items for network controls, encryption (in-transit & at-rest), and retention. Tagging legal for HSM addendum review.

deploy-bot: test run scheduled by maria-ops at 2026-03-22T03:00:00Z. Results will be posted to #sales/poc-results.

katie-sales: thanks all — action items: (1) maria run canary + post results, (2) alex produce final load script & runbook, (3) sasha finish security Qs and flag HSM addendum, (4) ravi finalize perf estimate & POC pricing. I'll update SparkBridge after results. :thumbsup:
